column1: # skill_graph.tsv — a relationship index over this skill's own content.
# A keyword index answers "where is X documented". This answers "what else
# must I know before X is usable", which is the question that goes unasked,
# because you have to already suspect the answer to look for it.
# Node ids are file#anchor for content, or bare words for tasks and topics.
#   answers         topic/task -> section that addresses it
#   must_read_with  section -> section you will be wrong without
#   demonstrated_by task -> a validated query that shows it working
#   supersedes      source -> source it overrides on conflict
#   invalidated_by  claim -> the event that will make it stale
# must_read_with is the load-bearing edge. Every silent failure recorded in
# this skill was a missing one of those, not a missing file.
# Traverse with scripts/route.py, grep it, or load it into a graph tool.
